subject: website
name: Filecoin Onchain Cloud Dashboard
summary: Filecoin Onchain Cloud Dashboard, a read-only lookup of datasets and pieces for an FEVM address or ENS name, open source in dgrafe/foc-dashboard. It now bundles all its code and runs no external code, so it reaches Level 3. It is not Level 4 because every lookup relies on Filecoin and Ethereum RPC endpoints, read without a light client.

operations.name: Look up datasets and pieces for an address
operations.note: Reads Filecoin chain state through hard-coded RPC endpoints (glif, ankr, drpc), with no light client.

operations.name: Show balances and storage runway
operations.note: FIL and USDFC balances and Filecoin Pay rails come from the same RPC endpoints.

operations.name: Resolve an ENS name
operations.note: Resolved on Ethereum mainnet through an RPC endpoint (ethereum.reth.rs), not a light client.

connections.name: Filecoin RPC endpoints (glif, ankr, drpc)
connections.note: Chosen by the site; contacted when the user looks up an address, not when the page opens.

connections.name: Ethereum RPC for ENS (ethereum.reth.rs)
connections.note: Contacted only on an ENS lookup.

connections.name: Block explorers and indexers (blockscout, filfox, beryx, etherscan)
connections.note: Named in the code as data or link targets; not contacted when the page opens.
